limitations: Pulse definition: previous>=21channel negative-edge clusters, not an optical template fit.
Endpoint kept fixed to avoid pairing different boards as separate flashes.
Events with>=3candidates contribute multiple consecutive pairs.
Selection window truncates allowed separations;10us cluster merging suppresses closer pairs.
Timing resolution2.048us and uncorrected board latency; no implication that decimal separations are exact physical delays.
Self-triggered packet selection/recording duration and potential ringing/digital artifacts can affect pair spacing.
No matched background pair distribution; no significance or random-noise rejection claimed.

limits: Existing exploratory tests, not a newly established cause.
First pulse means first retained candidate in the selected window, not necessarily the first physical pulse.
Missing PDS samples and ADC rail bins remain gaps. Raw ADC is not calibrated light.
A threshold crossing is a timing marker, not a physical start time.
Charge segments are 2D raw-signal features, not fitted 3D tracks.
